title: KS-1389: Approve the coordinated slot-target.sh / preflight leg 13 / pre-push change?
bluf: Nothing is broken today. Sourcing slot-target.sh with no slot silently exports slot 1's targets, and preflight leg 13 plus the pre-push hook rely on that on purpose, so it cannot simply be made to refuse (every push would be refused). Fixing it means changing three pieces together, including the pre-push hook and preflight, which affect every developer's push (Peter, Stuart, you). The ticket now also lists this as part of a five-ticket 'no silent slot-1 default' group. Peter raised it for you rather than touch your files.

sources.quote: No action is needed today, and nothing is broken on the trunk
leg 13's positive control would then refuse every push
the three pieces have to move together, and the hook and preflight are yours
Peter's ruling (2026-09-29): raise it for you rather than change your files

options.label: Approve the 3-part change (agent build; edits pre-push hook + preflight for all pushers)
options.detail: slot-target.sh refuses unslotted; leg 13 measures with an explicit slot; pre-push reports SKIPPED not slot 1. Size M, needs a QA gate. Changes every dev's push flow.

options.label: Accept as-is: leave slot-target.sh, leg 13 and the hook unchanged
options.detail: No change. The TypeScript harnesses already refuse unslotted runs; the export remains the last silent slot-1 default.

default_action: After 48 h nothing changes (option b): no edit to slot-target.sh, preflight or the pre-push hook. Safest and fully reversible; you can still approve later.
